estimates.assumptions: Using supplied knownGrams exactly as given for the 227g clotted cream line; caloriesPer100g left null because no value was supplied in targets and the instruction is to estimate only null fields while copying supplied known values exactly.
1 tsp corn flour (cornstarch) is realistically ~3 g based on standard density of ~0.5 g/ml for 5 ml teaspoon; caloriesPer100g left null because no value was supplied in targets.

'Grated' nutmeg is a modest 'to taste' amount; realistically ~1-2 g for a small grating (a whole nutmeg is ~5-7 g total); using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly and modest realistic weight for seasoning.

'Chopped' parsley for sprinkling to finish is a modest garnish amount realistically ~4-6 g (a small handful); using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly and modest realistic weight for seasoning/herb garnish.
